about: Reading a type you have never seen. Every case supplies a type definition and asks a question a consumer needs answered without knowing the producer's vocabulary.

cases.why: The consumer has never heard of an Errand and must not need to. Completion is read through the declared mapping, not inferred from a field called 'status' or a value called 'done'.
Completion is a set, not a single value. Abandoned counts as complete for this producer; a consumer must respect that rather than treating only the last option as done.

One producer's compound field maps onto two of a profile's scalars. A consumer must follow the part mapping rather than assuming a field named 'due' exists, and must not assume the labels are Start and Due — they are producer text.

This type has a field called status with a value called done and is still not a task. A consumer that infers task-ness from field names will import the user's recipe box into their to-do list. Absence of a declaration is information.
A type can satisfy several profiles at once. A calendar tool reads it as an event, a notes tool reads it as a note, and neither has to be told which the producer 'really' meant.

Profiles outside the v0 vocabulary are ignored for consumption but must survive a round-trip. A producer experimenting with a habit profile loses nothing by declaring it, which is how a vocabulary grows without a committee.
